summary: D.R. Horton filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 disclosing that its board authorized an additional $5.0 billion share repurchase program with no expiration date, leaving approximately $53 million under the prior authorization. Management expects total fiscal 2026 repurchases of at least $3.25 billion. No price, premium, advisor, or closing date is stated. The open-ended authorization gives the builder substantial buyback capacity, signaling capital-return priority amid housing-cycle uncertainty; watch quarterly share-count reduction, cash flow versus land spend, and whether repurchases accelerate or slow with mortgage-rate-driven demand.
